title: Return the lexicographically smallest topological order
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Kahn's algorithm over every node with a min-heap of ready nodes always takes the smallest candidate, counts duplicate edges consistently and raises ValueError on any cycle.
A first-in first-out queue does not take the smallest ready node, so topo_order(["a", "b", "c", "d"], [("d", "a"), ("c", "b")]) returns ["c", "d", "b", "a"] instead of ["c", "b", "d", "a"].
Each step places the smallest node with no unplaced predecessors, which is exactly the brief's rule, and a step with no free node raises ValueError.
It builds the graph from edges alone, so topo_order(["z", "a"], []) returns [] instead of ["a", "z"], and the note claiming the owner agreed to drop nodes without edges is not part of the brief.
